message: 予想された敗北

name: Pasta
message: 「Soltia!」

name: Soltia
message: 「This is the combat log from the battle against the Crusaders that took place two hours and three minutes ago, measured in human time.」

name: Pasta
message: 「When did you record something like this, nya!」

name: Soltia
message: 「What a magnificent defeat, Pasta.」

name: Soltia
message: 「You said earlier that everything was proceeding smoothly according to plan today and there was nothing in particular to report, didn't you?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Ah... th-that's, nya.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Are you saying that your subordinates being defeated by the Crusaders was also part of the plan?」

name: Pasta
message: 「...I told you, that's...」
Pasta glanced nervously at Bylous's expression.

name: Soltia
message: 「Did you try to hide it because you were afraid of being called incompetent?」

name: Pasta
message: 「What was that?! Pasta wasn't trying to hide anything, nya! The construction of the magic circle is progressing right on schedule, nya!」

name: Azel
message: 「Up until today.」

name: Soltia
message: 「But what about from here on out? Their interference might throw the schedule off track, you know?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Th-that's...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Even though there's less than two months until Re-Crea... I dread to think what lies ahead.」

name: Azel
message: 「'I hope it goes well,' huh. So this is what they call hypocrisy.」

name: Soltia
message: 「What?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Regardless of what you think, Re-Crea will happen.」

name: Soltia
message: 「How nice for you. Must be carefree being a fanatic.」

name: Bylous
message: 「That's enough.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Judging from the records, the gap in strength between us and them is slight. We lost this time, but if we fight them again, there's a chance we can win.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Hmph. A slight gap in strength... huh.」

name: Pasta
message: 「It's just like Bylous-nyama says, nya! If we fight them again, we'll win, nya! Tonight was just a fluke, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Damn those Crusaders! Getting all full of themselves over one lucky win--I'm gonna beat them black and blue, nya!」

name: Bylous
message: 「As for dealing with the Crusaders, Pasta. I'll leave it to you.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Leave it to me, nya!」
